summary: Iteration 2 covers new admin JWT auth, protected leads endpoints, lead-magnet PDF guide, city landing pages, and Google reviews section. Backend 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend E2E passed for admin login/dashboard/logout, ProtectedRoute redirect, guide download success, /areas grid + Daytona/Orlando city pages, Google reviews section on home, and Areas nav link.

issues: Total leads stats card text/number appears very low-contrast (dim gray on dark surface) — icon and '6' number are barely readable. Consider brighter text (text-white/90) for the number and stronger label color.

action_items: Optional: improve contrast on Lead dashboard stats card (currently very dim).
critical_code_review_comments: Auth implementation follows playbook: bcrypt ($2b$), JWT HS256, brute-force lockout after 5 attempts (15 min), idempotent seed_admin that updates password if changed — verified.

get_current_admin: uses Bearer header only (no httpOnly cookie). Playbook mentions httpOnly cookies but this app uses localStorage bearer tokens by design (documented). Acceptable, but if cookie-based required, needs refactor.
PATCH /api/leads/{id} accepts arbitrary status string (no enum). Consider validating status values (new|contacted|scheduled|closed).
server.py:315 CORS allow_origins defaults to ['*'] with allow_credentials=True — invalid combo per CORS spec when credentials used. Set explicit origins via CORS_ORIGINS env var in production.
generate_guide_pdf regenerated on every /api/guide/download call — fine for low volume, but cache in-memory once for perf if traffic grows.
seed_data_creation: Created leads via API: TEST_John Doe (contact), TEST_Guide User (guide), TEST_Guide FE (guide) via frontend E2E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env. All admin routes require Bearer token in Authorization header stored in localStorage['fg_admin_token']. Loader intro (~1.4s) can be bypassed via sessionStorage.setItem('fg_loaded','1'). Brute-force lockout after 5 failed logins per ip+email for 15 minutes — use unique wrong password if re-testing to avoid interference (test uses one-off password once).
